To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of fermented soybean meal (FSBM) as a protein supplement in the diet of growing pigs can improve the nutritional quality of the protein in soybean meal, as compared to the control soybean meal (SM).

soybean meal fermented with Aspergillus or Aspergillus followed by Lactobacllus fermentation increased protein digestibility, available lysine content and essential amino acids in soybean meal, especially the Aspergillus fermentation followed by Lactoabacillus fermentation.
the fermentation of soybean meal by and/or followed by fermentation improved protein quality, especially through Lactobacilli fermentation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nutritional quality of single-stage- and two-stage- fermented SBM and SPC.
the nutritional value of fermented SBM.
the nutritional value of fermented SBM and SPC in broilers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the nutritional quality of fermented SBM, especially through the subsequent Lactobacilli fermentation is improved and comparable to the nutritional quality of unfermented soy protein concentrates (SPCs) and is compatible with the use of SPCs.
the nutritional quality of fermented SBM was significantly improved and was comparable to the SPC.
fermented SBM is a good source of protein for poultry and is compatible with other high quality protein sources such as SPC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fermentation by and/or could be used to improve the nutritional quality of SBM.
the fermentation process could be an effective way to improve the nutritional quality of SBM and SPC, and it could also provide a new way to produce fermented soybean meal as a feed ingredient.
the fermentation process of SBM could be a promising way to improve the nutritional quality of SBM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a single stage or two stage-fermented SBM could be a potential alternative to SPC for the production of low protein, high energy and high fiber diets for pigs.
the fermentation of SBM by A. oryzae and subsequent Lactobacilli fermentation can be a useful strategy to improve the nutritional quality of SBM.
fermentation can be used to increase the nutritional value of soybeans.
